title: Writing: Review a Film or Book
writingModel: 'October Sky' is an inspiring film that is based on a true story. It tells the story of Homer Hickam, a teenager who grows up in a coal-mining town and dreams of becoming a rocket scientist.

The film, which was directed by Joe Johnston, is set in 1957 — the year the Soviet Union launched Sputnik. Watching a satellite cross the night sky changes Homer's life forever. He starts building rockets with his friends, despite the disapproval of his father, who wants him to work in the mine.

What I love most is the theme of believing in yourself even when others doubt you. Homer is a character who never gives up, no matter how many failures he faces. The relationship between Homer and his father, which starts out as conflict, develops into something much more beautiful.
I highly recommend this film to anyone who has ever had a dream that seemed impossible. It is a film that reminds you: if you work hard enough and believe in yourself, anything is possible.
